_comment: Source scanners whose reads cannot be inferred from direct source-tree literals (#2495). Both check-touched-shards (scoped-test and queue-derived filters) and the lander's test_impact read this registry from the candidate tree. A production edit in a file naming a token on either side selects every listed test; this deliberately includes companion behavioural tests, even for new sites. Test-only and comment-only edits retain ordinary selection. Add future scanners here, not as per-file exceptions.
